sentences.en: Senior executives spend a lot of time training their subordinates.
sentences.zh: 高级主管花了很多时间培训下属。

sentences.en: All the other issues are subordinate to this one.
sentences.zh: 其他所有问题都必须服从于这个问题。

sentences.en: I was stabbed in the back by my subordinate.
sentences.zh: 我被下属背后捅了一刀。

senses.zh: 使处于次要地位；使从属于

mnemonic: sub（下面）+ordin（顺序）+ate→下面的顺序→附属的
